objectivesText: Slay Fineous Darkvire and recover the great hammer, Ironfel. Take Ironfel to the Shrine of Thaurissan and place it on the statue of Franclorn Forgewright.

quests.name: Disharmony of Flame
objectivesText: Travel to the quarry in Blackrock Mountain and slay Overmaster Pyron. Return to Thunderheart when you have completed this assignment.

quests.name: Disharmony of Fire
objectivesText: Enter Blackrock Depths and track down Lord Incendius. Slay him and return any source of information you may find to Thunderheart.

quests.name: Commander Gor'shak
objectivesText: Find Commander Gor'shak in Blackrock Depths.
You recall that the crudely drawn picture of the orc included bars drawn over the portrait. Perhaps you should search for a prison of some sort.

quests.name: A Taste of Flame
objectivesText: Show Cyrus Therepentous the Black Dragonflight Molt you received from Kalaran Windblade.

quests.name: A Taste of Flame
objectivesText: Show Cyrus Therepentous proof of your worth.
You have a feeling that Cyrus already knows that you are unworthy.

quests.name: A Taste of Flame
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay Bael'Gar.
You only know that the giant resides inside Blackrock Depths. Remember to use the Altered Black Dragonflight Molt on Bael'Gar's remains to capture the Fiery Essence.
Return the Encased Fiery Essence to Cyrus Therepentous.

quests.name: The Rise of the Machines
objectivesText: Venture to the Burning Steppes and recover 10 Fractured Elemental Shards for Hierophant Theodora Mulvadania.
You recall Theodora mentioning the golems and elementals of that region as being a source for these shards.

quests.name: The Rise of the Machines
objectivesText: Take the Elemental Shard Sample to Lotwil Veriatus.
You recall Theodora saying that Lotwil was stationed in a camp to the east.

quests.name: The Rise of the Machines
objectivesText: Find and slay Golem Lord Argelmach. Return his head to Lotwil. You will also need to collect 10 Intact Elemental Cores from the Ragereaver Golems and Warbringer Constructs protecting Argelmach. You know this because you are psychic.

quests.name: KILL ON SIGHT: Dark Iron Dwarves
objectivesText: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors!
Warlord Goretooth wants you to kill 15 Anvilrage Guardsmen, 10 Anvilrage Wardens and 5 Anvilrage Footmen. Return to him once your task is complete.

quests.name: KILL ON SIGHT: High Ranking Dark Iron Officials
objectivesText: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors!
Warlord Goretooth wants you to kill 10 Anvilrage Medics, 10 Anvilrage Soldiers and 10 Anvilrage Officers. Return to him once your task is complete.

quests.name: Precarious Predicament
objectivesText: Escort your prisoner, Grark Lorkrub, through Burning Steppes and through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge.
You recall Lexlort mentioning that he would have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody.
You will also be required to hand over your Thorium Shackles to Lexlort.

quests.name: Grark Lorkrub
objectivesText: Travel to the Burning Steppes and find Grark Lorkrub. You recall Lexlort mentioning that he was last seen in a massive Blackrock fortress.

When you find Grark Lorkrub, use the Thorium Shackles to bind him and then lead him back through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge. Lexlort will have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody.

quests.name: The Heart of the Mountain
objectivesText: Bring the Heart of the Mountain to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Hurley Blackbreath
objectivesText: Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Ragnar Thunderbrew in Kharanos.

quests.name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
objectivesText: Speak with Ragnar Thunderbrew.

quests.name: Operation: Death to Angerforge
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay General Angerforge! Return to Warlord Goretooth when the task is complete.

quests.name: Vivian Lagrave
objectivesText: Speak with Shadowmaster Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

quests.name: Lost Thunderbrew Recipe
objectivesText: Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

quests.name: Ribbly Screwspigot
objectivesText: Bring Ribbly's Head to Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: The Love Potion
objectivesText: Bring 4 Gromsblood, 10 Giant Silver Veins and Nagmara's Filled Vial to Mistress Nagmara in Blackrock Depths.

quests.name: Overmaster Pyron
objectivesText: Slay Overmaster Pyron and return to Jalinda Sprig.
You recall Jalinda talking about Pyron guarding the quarry. Perhaps you should search there?

quests.name: Incendius!
objectivesText: Find Lord Incendius in Blackrock Depths and destroy him!

quests.name: The Good Stuff
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 20 Dark Iron Fanny Packs. Return to Oralius when you have completed this task. You assume that the Dark Iron dwarves inside Blackrock Depths carry these 'fanny pack' contraptions.

quests.name: Yuka Screwspigot
objectivesText: Speak with Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Kharan Mighthammer
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Depths and find Kharan Mighthammer.
The King mentioned that Kharan was being held prisoner there - perhaps you should try looking for a prison.

quests.name: Kharan's Tale
objectivesText: Listen as Kharan Mighthammer tells his story.

quests.name: The Bearer of Bad News
objectivesText: Return to Ironforge and deliver the bad news to King Magni Bronzebeard.

quests.name: The Fate of the Kingdom
objectivesText: Return to Blackrock Depths and rescue Princess Moira Bronzebeard from the evil clutches of Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.

quests.name: The Princess's Surprise
objectivesText: Return to Ironforge and speak with King Magni Bronzebeard.

quests.name: Put Her Down
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy the source of the worg menace. As you left Helendis, he shouted a name: Halycon. It is what the orcs refer to in regards to the worg.

quests.name: The Pack Mistress
objectivesText: Slay Halycon, pack mistress of the Bloodaxe worg.

quests.name: Broodling Essence
objectivesText: Bring 8 Broodling Essence and the Draco-Incarcinatrix 900 to Tinkee Steamboil at the Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Kibler's Exotic Pets
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Bloodaxe Worg Pups. Use the cage to carry the ferocious little beasts. Bring back a Caged Worg Pup to Kibler.

quests.name: Egg Freezing
objectivesText: Use the Eggscilloscope Prototype on an egg in the Rookery.

quests.name: Egg Collection
objectivesText: Bring 8 Collected Dragon Eggs and the Collectronic Module to Tinkee Steamboil at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Doomrigger's Clasp
objectivesText: Bring Doomrigger's Clasp to Mayara Brightwing in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Delivery to Ridgewell
objectivesText: Bring Ridgewell's Crate to Remington Ridgewell in Stormwind.

quests.name: Mayara Brightwing
objectivesText: Speak with Mayara Brightwing in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: The Darkstone Tablet
objectivesText: Bring the Darkstone Tablet to Shadow Mage Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

quests.name: Vivian Lagrave and the Darkstone Tablet
objectivesText: Speak with Shadowmage Vivian Lagrave.

quests.name: Dawn's Gambit
objectivesText: Place Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room of the Scholomance. Defeat Vectus, then return to Betina Bigglezink.

quests.name: The Ancient Egg
objectivesText: Bring the Ancient Egg to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

quests.name: The Final Tablets
objectivesText: Bring the Fifth and Sixth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.

quests.name: Felnok Steelspring
objectivesText: Give Tinkee's Letter to Felnok Steelspring.

quests.name: Chillwind Horns
objectivesText: Bring 8 Uncracked Chillwind Horns to Felnok Steelspring.

quests.name: Return to Tinkee
objectivesText: Bring Felnok's Package to Tinkee Steamboil in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: En-Ay-Es-Tee-Why
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 15 Spire Spider Eggs for Kibler.
By the sound of it, these eggs could be found near spiders.

quests.name: Mother's Milk
objectivesText: In the heart of Blackrock Spire you will find Mother Smolderweb. Engage her and get her to poison you. Chances are good that you will have to kill her as well. Return to Ragged John when you are poisoned so that he can 'milk' you.

quests.name: Urok Doomhowl
objectivesText: Read Warosh's Scroll. Bring Warosh's Mojo to Warosh.

quests.name: Warlord's Command
objectivesText: Slay Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Recover Important Blackrock Documents. Return to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath when the mission has been accomplished.

quests.name: Tinkee Steamboil
objectivesText: Speak with Tinkee Steamboil.

quests.name: Eitrigg's Wisdom
objectivesText: Speak with Eitrigg in Orgrimmar. When you have discussed matters with Eitrigg, seek council from Thrall.
You recall having seen Eitrigg in Thrall's chamber.

quests.name: For The Horde!
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Warchief Rend Blackhand. Take his head and return to Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Operative Bijou
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find out what happened to Bijou.

quests.name: Bijou's Belongings
objectivesText: Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. You recall her mentioning that she stashed them on the bottom floor of the city.

quests.name: Bijou's Reconnaissance Report
objectivesText: Take Bijou's Reconnaissance Report back to Grandmaster Lexlort in Kargath.

quests.name: Bijou's Belongings
objectivesText: Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. Good luck!

quests.name: Message to Maxwell
objectivesText: Travel to the Burning Steppes and give Bijou's Information to Marshal Maxwell.

quests.name: The Lost Tablets of Mosh'aru
objectivesText: Bring the Third and Fourth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.

quests.name: Maxwell's Mission
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy War Master Voone, Highlord Omokk, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.

quests.name: General Drakkisath's Command
objectivesText: Take General Drakkisath's Command to Marshal Maxwell in Burning Steppes.

quests.name: General Drakkisath's Demise
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy General Drakkisath. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.

quests.name: The Matron Protectorate
objectivesText: Travel to Winterspring and find Haleh. Give her Awbee's scale.

quests.name: The Flesh Does Not Lie
objectivesText: Recover 10 Plagued Flesh Samples from Stratholme and return them to Betina Bigglezink. You suspect that any creature in Stratholme would have said flesh sample.

quests.name: The Active Agent
objectivesText: Travel to Stratholme and search the ziggurats. Find and return new Scourge Data to Betina Bigglezink.

quests.name: Houses of the Holy
objectivesText: Travel to Stratholme, in the north. Search the supply crates that litter the city and recover 5 Stratholme Holy Water. Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered when you have collected enough of the blessed fluid.

quests.name: The Archivist
objectivesText: Travel to Stratholme and find Archivist Galford of the Scarlet Crusade. Destroy him and burn down the Scarlet Archive.

quests.name: The Truth Comes Crashing Down
objectivesText: Take the Head of Balnazzar to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Above and Beyond
objectivesText: Venture to Stratholme and destroy Baron Rivendare. Take his head and return to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff.

quests.name: The Restless Souls
objectivesText: Find Egan. You only know that he was last seen around Stratholme.

quests.name: The Restless Souls
objectivesText: Use Egan's Blaster on the ghostly and spectral citizens of Stratholme. When the restless souls break free from their ghostly shells, use the blaster again - freedom will be theirs!
Free 15 Restless Souls and return to Egan.

quests.name: Barov Family Fortune
objectivesText: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Alexi Barov when you have completed this task.

quests.name: Barov Family Fortune
objectivesText: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Weldon Barov when you have completed this task.

quests.name: Doctor Theolen Krastinov, the Butcher
objectivesText: Find Doctor Theolen Krastinov inside the Scholomance. Destroy him, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff. Return to Eva Sarkhoff when the task is complete.

quests.name: Kirtonos the Herald
objectivesText: Return to the Scholomance with the Blood of Innocents. Find the porch and place the Blood of Innocents in the brazier. Kirtonos will come to feast upon your soul.
Fight valiantly, do not give an inch! Destroy Kirtonos and return to Eva Sarkhoff.

quests.name: The Human, Ras Frostwhisper
objectivesText: Travel to the Arathi Highlands, to the ruins of Stromgarde. Search Stromgarde for a Keepsake of Remembrance. If you find such an item, return with it to Magistrate Marduke.

quests.name: The Dying, Ras Frostwhisper
objectivesText: Travel to Light's Hope in Eastern Plaguelands and seek out Leonid Barthalomew the Revered. Show him the Keepsake of Remembrance and tell him all that you have discovered.

quests.name: Menethil's Gift
objectivesText: Travel to Stratholme and find Menethil's Gift. Place the Keepsake of Remembrance upon the unholy ground.

quests.name: Menethil's Gift
objectivesText: Take the Soulbound Keepsake to Leonid Barthalomew in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Soulbound Keepsake
objectivesText: Return to Magistrate Marduke in Caer Darrow. Show him the Soulbound Keepsake.

quests.name: The Lich, Ras Frostwhisper
objectivesText: Find Ras Frostwhisper in the Scholomance. When you have found him, use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper. Take the head back to Magistrate Marduke.

quests.name: Krastinov's Bag of Horrors
objectivesText: Locate Jandice Barov in the Scholomance and destroy her. From her corpse recover Krastinov's Bag of Horrors. Return the bag to Eva Sarkhoff.

quests.name: The Gordok Ogre Suit
objectivesText: Bring 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 8 Rugged Leather, 2 Rune Threads, and Ogre Tannin to Knot Thimblejack. He is currently chained inside the Gordok wing of Dire Maul.

quests.name: Leonid Barthalomew
objectivesText: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Leonid Barthalomew in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Plagued Hatchlings
objectivesText: Kill 20 Plagued Hatchlings, then return to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel.

quests.name: Betina Bigglezink
objectivesText: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Betina Bigglezink.

quests.name: Searching for the Lost Satchel
objectivesText: Search Ragefire Chasm for Maur Grimtotem's corpse and search it for any items of interest.

quests.name: Testing an Enemy's Strength
objectivesText: Search Orgrimmar for Ragefire Chasm, then kill 8 Ragefire Troggs and 8 Ragefire Shaman before returning to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Returning the Lost Satchel
objectivesText: Take the Grimtotem Satchel to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: The Power to Destroy...
objectivesText: Bring the books Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether to Varimathras in Undercity.

quests.name: Hidden Enemies
objectivesText: Bring a Lieutenant's Insignia to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Hidden Enemies
objectivesText: Take the Lieutenant's Insignia to Neeru Fireblade and speak to him. Gauge if he believes you are a member of the Burning Blade and then return to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Hidden Enemies
objectivesText: Kill Bazzalan and Jergosh the Invoker before returning to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Slaying the Beast
objectivesText: Enter Ragefire Chasm and slay Taragaman the Hungerer, then bring his heart back to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: An Unholy Alliance
objectivesText: Bring Ambassador Malcin's Head to Varimathras in the Undercity.

quests.name: An Unholy Alliance
objectivesText: Take the Small Scroll to Varimathras in the Undercity.

quests.name: Blackfathom Villainy
objectivesText: Bring the head of Twilight Lord Kelris to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Trouble in the Deeps
objectivesText: Speak to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

quests.name: The Essence of Aku'Mai
objectivesText: Bring 20 Sapphires of Aku'Mai to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

quests.name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
objectivesText: Bring the Damp Note to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

quests.name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
objectivesText: Kill Lorgus Jett in Blackfathom Deeps and then return to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

quests.name: A Host of Evil
objectivesText: Kill 8 Razorfen Battleguard, 8 Razorfen Thornweavers, and 8 Death's Head Cultists and return to Myriam Moonsinger near the entrance to Razorfen Downs.

quests.name: Test of Lore
objectivesText: Answer Braug Dimspirit's question successfully and then speak to him again. He will remain in Stonetalon Mountains when you are ready.

quests.name: Amongst the Ruins
objectivesText: Bring the Fathom Core to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.

quests.name: The Glowing Shard
objectivesText: Travel to Ratchet to find someone that can tell you more about the glowing shard.
Then, deliver the shard as you are directed.

quests.name: Twisted Evils
objectivesText: Collect 15 Theradric Crystal Carvings for Willow in Desolace.

quests.name: Vyletongue Corruption
objectivesText: Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon.
Use the Filled Cerulean Vial on the Vylestem Vines to force the corrupted Noxxious Scion to emerge.
Heal 8 plants by killing these Noxxious Scion, then return to Vark Battlescar in Shadowprey Village.

quests.name: Vyletongue Corruption
objectivesText: Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon.
Use the Filled Cerulean Vial on the Vylestem Vines to force the corrupted Noxxious Scion to emerge.
Heal 8 plants by killing these Noxxious Scion, then return to Talendria in Nijel's Point.

quests.name: Legends of Maraudon
objectivesText: Recover the two parts of the Scepter of Celebras: the Celebrian Rod and the Celebrian Diamond.
Find a way to speak with Celebras.

quests.name: The Scepter of Celebras
objectivesText: Assist Celebras the Redeemed while he creates the Scepter of Celebras.
Speak with him when the ritual is complete.

quests.name: Corruption of Earth and Seed
objectivesText: Slay Princess Theradras and return to Selendra near Shadowprey Village in Desolace.

quests.name: Corruption of Earth and Seed
objectivesText: Slay Princess Theradras and return to Keeper Marandis at Nijel's Point in Desolace.

quests.name: Seed of Life
objectivesText: Seek out Remulos in Moonglade and give him the Seed of Life.

quests.name: The Pariah's Instructions
objectivesText: Read the Pariah's Instructions. Afterwards, obtain the Amulet of Union from Maraudon and return it to the Centaur Pariah in southern Desolace.

quests.name: Shadowshard Fragments
objectivesText: Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Uthel'nay in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Shadowshard Fragments
objectivesText: Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Archmage Tervosh in Theramore on the coast of Dustwallow Marsh.

quests.name: The Last Element
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 10 Essence of the Elements. Your first inclination is to search the golems and golem makers. You remember Vivian Lagrave also muttering something about elementals.

quests.name: Pusillin and the Elder Azj'Tordin
objectivesText: Travel to Dire Maul and locate the Imp, Pusillin. Convince Pusillin to give you Azj'Tordin's Book of Incantations through any means necessary.
Return to Azj'Tordin at the Lariss Pavilion in Feralas should you recover the Book of Incantations.

quests.name: The Madness Within
objectivesText: You must destroy the guardians surrounding the 5 Pylons that power the Prison of Immol'thar. Once the Pylons have powered down, the force field surrounding Immol'thar will have dissipated.
Enter the Prison of Immol'thar and eradicate the foul demon that stands at its heart. Finally, confront Prince Tortheldrin in Athenaeum.
Return to the Shen'dralar Ancient in the courtyard should you complete this quest.

quests.name: Elven Legends
objectivesText: Search Dire Maul for Kariel Winthalus. Report back to Scholar Runethorn at Feathermoon with whatever information that you may find.

quests.name: Lethtendris's Web
objectivesText: Bring Lethtendris' Web to Latronicus Moonspear at the Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

quests.name: Feathermoon Stronghold
objectivesText: Speak with Latronicus Moonspear at the Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

quests.name: Unfinished Gordok Business
objectivesText: Find the Gauntlet of Gordok Might and return it to Captain Kromcrush in Dire Maul.
According to Kromcrush, the "old timey story" says that Tortheldrin - a "creepy" elf who called himself a prince - stole it from one of the Gordok kings.

quests.name: Blackhand's Command
objectivesText: That is one stupid orc. It would appear as if you need to find this brand and gain the Mark of Drakkisath in order to access the Orb of Command.
The letter indicates that General Drakkisath guards the brand. Perhaps you should investigate.
